qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Global #1 in plate heat exchangers, centrifugal separators, and hygienic fluid handling with established brand recognition, generating 12-16% EBIT margins and 15-20% ROCE.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 4 (CAP = 5, REJECT). Tier 3 Capital Goods baseline (10-15Y) degraded by ~70% OEM exposure to cyclical commercial shipbuilding and petrochemical capex cycles, combined with low-cost Asian competitive encroachment in plate heat exchangers.
qualitative.evidence: While holding leading positions in heat transfer and separation, aftermarket service represents only ~30% of sales, leaving 70% exposed to lumpy, cyclical OEM capex in Marine (shipyard orders) and Energy (refinery/petrochemicals). Gross margins and orders fluctuate with global industrial and shipping cycles, capping competitive advantage period below the 15-year threshold.
